headline: Your digital presence is
costing you deals.
problem.intro: You run a business that generates real revenue. But every week, a prospect lands on a website that doesn't reflect your level, compares you to a competitor with a sharper presence, and chooses them. Not because they're better. Because they look it. That's not a market problem. It's a systems problem.

points.title: A weak digital presence kills B2B credibility
points.desc: Decision-makers do their due diligence before they ever contact you. An outdated or generic site sends one message: 'This business hasn't invested in itself.' Your actual capabilities never even get evaluated.

points.title: Disconnected tools mean invisible revenue leaks
points.desc: Most businesses run on a patchwork of tools that don't talk to each other — website here, CRM there, automations nowhere. Every manual step is time your team isn't spending on revenue. Every lead that falls through the cracks is a silent loss.

points.title: The rebuild that's been on the backlog for 18 months
points.desc: Agencies quote 3–6 months and €20,000+. Results: average, and too late. The real cost isn't the agency fee — it's the pipeline you lose while waiting. There's a faster way that doesn't trade quality for speed.

headline: 5 days.
Zero surprises.
process.subtitle: No 3-hour scoping meetings. No endless back-and-forth. A refined 5-step process — you know exactly where things stand every day.

steps.title: Brief — 30 min
steps.desc: You fill in a questionnaire at your own pace (20 min), then we have a 30-min call. I extract your positioning, ideal client profile, and business goals. Everything else is on me.

steps.title: Mockup approved before dev
steps.desc: I design a custom mockup suited to your activity and identity: colours, typography, structure, sections. You approve visually. Not one line of code until you say go.

steps.title: Copywriting
steps.desc: I write all your site content: headline, service pages, about, SEO meta descriptions. Every word is designed to convince — not just fill space.

steps.title: Site development
steps.desc: The approved design goes into development. Fully responsive across all devices, optimised Core Web Vitals, booking system integrated, fast load times.

steps.title: Launch + handover
steps.desc: Your site goes live on your domain. I walk you through editing your own content in 30 minutes — no code, no dependencies on me. You're 100% autonomous from day one.

about.headline: Not an agency. Not a generalist. A system builder.
paragraphs: I design and build digital systems for established businesses — sites, automations, and custom tools that work together to generate revenue. I started in Parisian agencies, learned what creates real value and what just creates invoices, then went solo.
Today I work directly with you. No project manager between us, no junior handling your budget. One person, accountable for every deliverable from brief to launch.

My edge: I build my own products and use them every day. FreelanceOS — a complete operating system for freelancers — is live with real users. I build for clients the same way I build for myself: for production, not for portfolios.
about.currently: 🏗️ Building in public — FreelanceOS + CreatorOS alongside client work.

items.a: Established businesses generating meaningful revenue that need a digital presence and infrastructure that matches their level — consulting firms, growing SMEs, SaaS founders, services companies. If you run a real business and want a system that generates deals while you focus on running the company — we should talk.

items.q: Is 5 days really achievable without cutting corners?
items.a: Yes — because the process is built for speed without compromise. The brief is tight (30 min), the copy is AI-assisted, and the development uses a refined component library. What takes an agency 6 weeks takes me 5 days.

items.q: I don't have time to brief you. How does it work?
items.a: The brief happens in two steps: a questionnaire you fill at your own pace (20 min), then a 30-min call. I handle everything from there — copy, design, development. Your time investment is minimal.

items.q: Will the site be genuinely custom?
items.a: Yes. I design from scratch for your specific positioning and sector. No templates, no copy-paste from another client. Guaranteed to be unique — or I redo it.

items.q: Which technology do you use and why?
items.a: I choose based on your actual needs. For sites you want to edit yourself without touching code, I use visual tools with a built-in content editor. For more complex needs — member areas, client portals, custom logic — I build a custom app. I explain the options during our call.

items.q: Can I edit the site myself after delivery?
items.a: Yes — always. Editing your own content takes about 30 minutes to learn. I walk you through it at delivery. You're 100% autonomous after that.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with the result?
items.a: You approve the mockup before development starts. Not one line of code is written until you've signed off on the visual. Revisions are included in every offer.
50% upfront at project start, 50% on delivery. Bank transfer or Stripe. Invoice within 24h of your commitment.

items.q: What are the running costs after delivery?
items.a: Between €0 and €25/month depending on the technical solution — I recommend the most cost-effective option for your project. You remain 100% owner of everything. Zero lock-in.
